resources.string: Performs only user-started, locally calculated gestures for grid navigation.
Screen analysis active — automation is off
Automation active — stop is always available

Automatically navigates DigiWorld, detects the grid dynamically and collects energy. Enable accessibility once, then press START and confirm screen sharing when Android asks.\n\nIMPORTANT: Select Botamon as the visible sprite. Other sprites may prevent reliable player detection.
For testing, it is best to enable all options.
Never walks left. Visible energy is targeted directly; otherwise the bot stays horizontal and attacks an obstacle directly ahead. Disable this profile to restore the unchanged v3.1 planner.
When no energy is visible, repeatedly uses Dash until the HUD reaches 0. If the counter is temporarily unreadable, at most three safe attempts are made; no progress or a confirmed 0 stops it.
Only orange energy is a collection target. Claws, steps, Dash drops and other collectables are treated like empty walkable cells; pyramids remain obstacles.
While energy is visible, disables multi-step taps and rechecks the whole grid after every single move. Energy in the same column is collected vertically before continuing.

Only after a securely detected DWS grid: detects the broad game-message area and taps the safe lower-center area once or twice with slight randomization, at most every 10 seconds. It never taps after leaving DWS mode.
Removes left movement from every route search. This may skip items or require attack, dash or a safe stop when no forward route remains.
Enable only for capture problems before starting screen sharing
Experimental: moves summon taps slightly downward on devices where the visible touch lands above the yellow button. Changing this stops capture.

If something does not work, first use “Stop everything”, then fully close the game and DigiWorldExplorer. Start the game first and wait until the game is fully loaded. Only then open DigiWorldExplorer, press START and confirm screen sharing.

OFF by default. Automatically starts Network Defense Ops, waits through all five waves and then detects the distinctive red-and-black final boss banner. The bot repeatedly taps “Give up”, returns to the selection and starts the next attempt. This can count roughly 40 defeated enemies per run. Enable only inside Network Defense Ops.

Automatically uses the yellow summon button on supported ticket and Crest screens. Crest summons also confirm the additional dialog automatically. It keeps tapping briefly through loading and reward transitions and stops when the cost turns red. Disable this option whenever you want to summon manually.

Automatically starts supported VS and Tower challenges, waits without tapping during a battle, closes reward and loss dialogs, then starts the next run. The loss dialog is handled only after this loop has confirmed a VS or Tower screen, so other modes are not affected. The mode stops after 15 seconds without visible progress.
No game image received — capture is gray or black
Summon screen detected — auto summon off
No DigiWorld, summon or VS. Dungeon screen was detected for 1 minute. Capture and automation were stopped to protect the device.

Detects the small white food bubble on the main battle screen and taps it three times with safe randomized positions and timing. This helps you reach Bond/Friendship levels and the Partner-icon reward faster. For safety, detection runs at intervals; after enabling it may take up to 30 seconds before the first feeding starts. The main-screen layout and bubble must remain stable across multiple frames.

Planned: The app cycles through the visible partners, starts their growth, returns to the main world and feeds them when a food bubble is available. The originally selected partner should be restored afterwards. This feature is still in development and is intentionally disabled for now.

All three should be enabled. Background battery access prevents Android from stopping capture or accessibility while the app is running.

Open the DigiWorld screen, enable the overlay permission and wait for the scene to settle. Then start automation again. If the grid is missing or its lines do not align with the game cells, toggle Legacy capture size and restart automation.
Important: use Botamon as the visible partner sprite for reliable player detection.
Changing this stops capture. Restart automation afterwards.
First try enabling accessibility once. Then open Android Settings → Apps → DigiWorldExplorer Bot → three-dot menu and choose “Allow restricted settings”. Return here and enable accessibility again.
Bot does not work at all — restore defaults
Network Ops does not detect or start
VS / Tower Loop does not continue

Recommended default recovery: stop automation, fully close both apps, then open the game first and wait until it has loaded. Open DigiWorldExplorer Bot, press START and share the whole screen. Enable only one automation feature for the first test. Keep Legacy capture size off unless the captured image is gray, black or offset.
Default: off. Test it only when the grid is missing or misaligned.
Enable only Network Defense Ops, open its party/Attempt dialog and wait until party members and the Attempt button are fully visible. Do not tap while the game is still loading.

Enable Auto Summon, open a supported ticket or crest summon screen and wait until its buttons are fully visible. Do not leave another dialog open. If taps land above the button, enable Summon touch correction in Experimental settings and restart automation.

Enable VS / Tower Loop and open the challenge dialog completely. Start from this dialog rather than a loading or battle screen. After a loss, wait while the bot closes the result and recognizes the dialog again.

Return to the main game screen and keep the food bubble visible. Detection can take up to 30 seconds. If nothing happens, stop automation, reopen the game first, then restart the bot with only Bond & Friendship enabled for the first test.

Both checks below must be active and the overlay icon switch must be on. Accessibility must be connected right now—not merely enabled in Android settings. If it is missing, open accessibility, turn DigiWorldExplorer Bot control off and on again, then return here.
Accessibility is not connected. Reconnect it before testing the overlay.
